prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 44 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1123; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment kept growing well beyond what this injury usually needs, with more visits and new services added month after month.
- Objective tests go against the complaints: imaging is normal and the patient moved freely when observed outside the exam room.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot, reporting neck and low back strain. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms, and the initial presentation was reasonable for a soft tissue strain of this kind. There is no known prior injury to the cervical or lumbar regions. Over the course of care, the patient completed 44 visits, with additional services added progressively over several months. The duration and scope of treatment have extended well beyond what is typically required for a strain of this severity. Imaging of the cervical and lumbar spine was within normal limits. Observed movement outside the examination room was unrestricted and did not match the range of motion described during formal testing. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no duplicate or repeated charges for the same service.
